comment: Findings the port guard accepts, each pinned to one file's exact content (its git blob id at the tip): any change to the file flags it again, and an entry whose file changed or is gone is itself a finding (accepted-stale). Only cloud-aws and secret findings can be listed. CI reads this file from code/next, never from the pull request. Editing it is a guard edit, reviewed by hand.
